artifact.create.decision_rationale: CP-05 owns dependency-aware scheduling and dispatch; CP-07 is the required independent evidence reviewer.

artifact.verify.decision_rationale: CP-07 owns independent target verification; CP-05 supplies execution ordering and trace context.

test.recovery_path.decision_rationale: CP-05 owns bounded retry/recovery; CP-07 independently verifies the eventual target.

plugin.forensic_audit.decision_rationale: SKILL ANALYZER owns general analytical methods; A.S.F.R.E.E is the technical forensic specialist when source anatomy is required.

plugin.engineering_method.decision_rationale: Ponytail owns minimal-complete software engineering method and its evidence dossier; SDO retains source-write lifecycle ownership and Evaluator Team supplies independent quality judgement. The route is selected declaratively, but dispatch remains blocked until a verified plugin-skill host adapter is configured.

plugin.skill_analyzer_p0_pilot.decision_rationale: SKILL ANALYZER is the sole primary owner. The one P0 executor is OpenAI Responses API using one authenticated Streamable HTTP Remote MCP tool; no other skill, MCP tool or downstream capability is included.

plugin.vibe_coding_mentor_prd.decision_rationale: Vibe Coding Mentor owns non-IT product discovery, PRD/MVP specification and PRD-to-builder prompt compilation. This is a declarative route only. The generic plugin.skill.invoke capability remains NOT_CONFIGURED; HSO must return BLOCKED_CAPABILITY until a dedicated VCM private-source host adapter, endpoint, authentication/authorization contract and verified invocation receipt exist.

plugin.agent_ecosystem_intelligence.decision_rationale: AEIO owns external AI-agent repository intelligence and prompt blueprinting. SKILL ANALYZER supplies general method selection; A.S.F.R.E.E owns deep technical reconstruction; Evaluator Team supplies independent judgement; SDO owns accepted source engineering. This route is declarative only: the generic plugin.skill.invoke host capability is not configured for AEIO, so HSO must fail closed with BLOCKED_CAPABILITY until a verified host adapter, authorization contract and invocation receipt exist.
